The [[Moreldahl]] '''Swiftsure''' was a model of [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] that could carry up to 90 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and could go 70 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] vertically and 100 meters horizontally. It was sold by [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]].
